A Company Reinvented
The enterprise that shareholders knew as Ceylon Printers PLC — a commercial printer with roots
reaching back to 1958 — has this year completed its reinvention. The foundation was laid in
the prior year, when Ekta Global Pte Ltd acquired a controlling interest of 63.62% in November
2024 and set a new direction. The year under review is when that direction became a working
business under the name Kerner Haus Global Solutions PLC (KHGS). Under the Kerner Haus
brand, the Company now manages fully serviced office facilities for the international business-
process and knowledge-process outsourcing industry that increasingly looks to Sri Lanka as a
delivery destination. The transformation was neither cosmetic nor opportunistic. It was a deliberate
